purpose: A schematic of the rule and of the quantities it leaves open, for the paper on the two works. Text and arrows only, plus one tile of work 1 cut from an existing image; it shows no value that has not been shown before.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before any script for it exists and before anything is drawn. Seen before: everything of results/work1, results/work1_drawing, results/work2_words, results/sketch_sp_color and the conditions they were made on.

layout.colour: black, white and greys only (the figure must read in print without colour)
layout.direction: left to right, one row of boxes joined by arrows

boxes.text: a unit of text (a sentence in work 1, a word or spelling in work 2)
valence V and arousal A from a lexicon
the rule: V and A give fineness f, depth s and sharpness gamma
the field of the generator (a seed, four octaves)
the relief: height under a scale
the image of the relief (how it is drawn)

open_quantities.how: labels in a second row under the box they act on, each with the value taken in work 1 and in work 2 read from the conditions at drawing time, written as 'name: work 1 value / work 2 value'; a quantity that does not apply to a work is written as a dash

list.name: lexicon and its map
list.work2: the lexicon of work 2 and the map chosen for the main images (left as FILL until the blind judgement is scored; the schematic is drawn after that)

list.name: height scale
list.work1: common to the series (per-tile min-max shown next to it)

list.name: drawing
list.work1: grey; light from two directions; stretched
list.work2: grey, and grey with colour (FILL as above)

tile.what: the tile of the first sentence of work 1 under the common scale, cut from results/work1/common.png at its place in the layout of work 1 (no resampling), shown under the box 'image'
tile.check: the cut equals the tile drawn afresh by works/work1.py for sentence 1 byte for byte (else the run stops)

outputs: results/rule_schematic/rule_schematic.png and rule_schematic.json (provenance: the conditions read and their SHA-256)
not_claimed: A schematic of the steps; it makes no claim about the effect of any quantity. The values of work 2 marked FILL are written after the blind judgement is scored and committed before the schematic is drawn.
